D: A small-town pizzeria owner inherits a fortune and moves to New York, where he stays exactly himself.
P: Serve the pizza when Deeds is back at his shop in Mandrake Falls.
S: Pizza dough knots brushed with garlic butter and parmesan, marinara

Soft pizza dough knots baked golden and brushed with garlic parsley butter and parmesan, served with warm marinara for dipping. Cut 500g pizza dough into 12 strips, roll each into a 20cm rope and tie into a knot. Lay on a lined tray and rest 15 minutes. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes until golden. Melt 60g butter with 3 crushed garlic cloves and 2 tbsp chopped parsley. Brush the hot knots all over and scatter with 40g finely grated parmesan. Serve with 300ml warmed marinara sauce.
Greeting card cheese and tomato pinwheels
Puff pastry spirals with sundried tomato pesto, ham, basil and cheese

Flaky puff pastry rolled with sundried tomato pesto, ham, basil and cheese, sliced into pinwheels and baked golden. Lay 2 sheets thawed puff pastry flat. Spread each with 2 tbsp sundried tomato pesto, then top with 4 slices of ham, a few basil leaves and 60g grated tasty cheese. Roll up tightly, chill for 15 minutes, then cut each roll into 12 slices. Lay cut-side down on a lined tray, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 18 minutes until puffed and golden.
M: Pepperoni, garlic mushroom and mozzarella pizza with chilli oil

A hand-stretched pizza with rich tomato sauce, mozzarella, pepperoni and garlic mushrooms, finished with oregano and chilli oil. Divide 750g pizza dough into 2 and stretch each into a 30cm round on oiled trays. Spread each with 100ml pizza sauce. Fry 200g sliced mushrooms with 1 crushed garlic clove in 1 tbsp oil for 4 minutes. Top the bases with 300g grated mozzarella, 120g pepperoni and the mushrooms. Bake at 240C for 12 to 14 minutes until blistered. Scatter with dried oregano and drizzle with chilli oil.
W: New York baked cheesecake with berries
Baked cheesecake on a biscuit base with warm berry sauce

A dense, creamy baked vanilla cheesecake on a buttery biscuit base, topped with a glossy mixed berry sauce. Crush 200g plain sweet biscuits and mix with 80g melted butter. Press into a lined 20cm springform tin and chill. Beat 500g soft cream cheese with 150g caster sugar, then beat in 3 eggs, 150g sour cream, 1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp vanilla. Pour over the base and bake at 150C for 55 minutes until just set. Cool in the oven with the door ajar, then chill 4 hours. Simmer 300g frozen berries with 50g sugar for 5 minutes and spoon over.
K: Cola poured over vanilla ice cream, whipped cream and a cherry

Ice-cold cola poured over scoops of vanilla ice cream so it foams up, served in tall glasses with a cherry and a long spoon. Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Add 2 scoops vanilla ice cream to each glass. Slowly pour cold cola down the side of each glass until it foams to the top, letting it settle and topping up, about 300ml per glass. Finish with a spoon of whipped cream from 100ml thickened cream and a cocktail cherry. Serve with straws and long spoons.

note.text: Eat up, folks. Big city or small town, a good pizza fixes most things, and I'm happy to prove it.

Beat the cream cheese with most of the sugar, then the eggs, sour cream, lemon juice and vanilla.
Pour over the base and bake at 150C until just set.
Cool in the oven with the door ajar.
Chill until firm.
Simmer the berries with the remaining sugar and spoon over.
Chill tall glasses in the freezer.
Add ice cream to each glass.
Slowly pour cola down the side until it foams to the top, letting it settle and topping up.
Finish with whipped cream and a cherry. Serve with straws and long spoons.
